_note: Mots ajoutés aux applis pour Logos et pour le Cerveau (clé « appli » ou « appli.action ») ; ils s'AJOUTENT aux mots français, ne retirent rien.

textes.rienCompris: Without an AI, I couldn't understand this request well enough to act: I did nothing. Say « help » to see what I can do without an AI.
textes.garde: No AI is answering right now. I'm keeping your question and will come back to it as soon as one does.
textes.pasEncore: I can't {quoi} yet: I did nothing. What I can do: {proche}.
textes.pasCetteLangue: Without an AI, I recognise the language of your request ({nom}), but I don't understand it yet: I need a language model to understand it. I did nothing; I'm keeping your question and will answer as soon as an AI is back.
textes.ilMeManque: {action}: I need « {quoi} ». Give it to me (or say « never mind »).
textes.jeNeConnaisPas: {action}: I don't know « {chose} » there. I did nothing: say it again with the exact name (or « never mind »).
textes.faitSansIA: Done without an AI: none is answering right now.
textes.modelePasEntraine: I can't {quoi} yet: my own {sorte} model isn't trained yet. What I can do right now: {proche}.

reserver.quoi: book anything with someone else (restaurant, hotel, cinema, travel)
reserver.proche: search the web for addresses, opening hours and prices, or set you a reminder

changer-billet.quoi: change, cancel or get a refund for a booking or a ticket
changer-billet.proche: search the web for the seller's help page, or set you a reminder

billet.quoi: buy a ticket (plane, train, show) or compare tickets
billet.proche: search the web for times and prices

acheter.quoi: buy or pay for anything for you
acheter.proche: search the web for prices; with an AI, I can also watch the price of a page

postuler.quoi: apply for a job for you
postuler.proche: search the web for job offers

newsletter.quoi: subscribe you to or unsubscribe you from a newsletter
newsletter.proche: with an AI, I find the unsubscribe link in the email and ask you before clicking

mails.quoi: read, sort, answer or send your emails and messages without an AI
mails.proche: with an AI, I do it, and every send or delete waits for your approval

vm-pause.proche: shut it down cleanly (with your approval) or take a snapshot (Hydre)

gpo.quoi: create or change a GPO (group policy) in a Windows domain
gpo.proche: with an AI, prepare the PowerShell script, which I only run with your approval

github-essai.quoi: try a GitHub repository in a separate container
github-essai.proche: have Pharos study the link; Argo runs an already published Docker image, with your approval

llm.quoi: serve a language model to other machines
llm.proche: Métis reads an open model for my own use (Métis page)

ecouter.quoi: listen to a sound or a voice message
ecouter.proche: read what you write to me

annoncer.quoi: speak on the speakers in the house
annoncer.proche: send you the message in writing

traduire.proche: keep the written conversation and its archive

prevoirMeteo.quoi: forecast the weather with my own model
prevoirMeteo.proche: compare the forecasts from public sources

reconnaitreSons.proche: measure a sound without a model: silence, volume, tempo, key
